Declare a criterion evaluated in R on a file the study holds

Source: R/cohort_criteria.R
local_criterion.Rd

For a source outside the warehouse. It runs after the pull's transaction, against the candidates that survived the warehouse criteria, so the provenance does not claim one snapshot covers it. The file's SHA-256 is taken when the criterion is declared, and again before and after decide() reads it. pull_master() refuses the pull if the file has changed since it was declared, or changed while it was read.

Usage

local_criterion(id, label, role, path, decide, undetermined)

Arguments

id

Character. The stage id: a letter, then letters, digits or underscores.

label

Character. The CONSORT label.

role

"include" or "exclude".

path

Character. The file the criterion reads.

decide

A function of (units, path). units is a data frame with cohort_unit, mrn and encounter_date, one row per candidate. It must return a logical vector with one value per row: TRUE met, FALSE not met, NA undetermined.

undetermined

"exclude", "keep" or "review".

Value

An object of class cohort_criterion.

See also

criterion(), cohort_query()

Examples

f <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
writeLines("mrn,covid_date", f)
local_criterion("covid_14d", "COVID-19 within 14 days", role = "exclude", path = f,
                decide = function(units, path) rep(FALSE, nrow(units)),
                undetermined = "review")
#> $id
#> [1] "covid_14d"
#> 
#> $label
#> [1] "COVID-19 within 14 days"
#> 
#> $role
#> [1] "exclude"
#> 
#> $path
#> [1] "/tmp/Rtmpt0Skxb/file1b0a4ffe423e.csv"
#> 
#> $sha256
#> [1] "b93be0af3b15ac48e7e3cdcd31e91c3f6a1e91d64d1d830f0e0136081fd8e887"
#> 
#> $decide
#> function (units, path) 
#> rep(FALSE, nrow(units))
#> <environment: 0x5aa7b7fb30b0>
#> 
#> $undetermined
#> [1] "review"
#> 
#> $kind
#> [1] "local"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "cohort_criterion"
